blocks.en: If a linear partial differential operator $L$ of order $m$ is elliptic at $\bm{x}_0\in\mathbb{R}^n$, $n>1$, then $m$ is an even integer ($m=2k$) and $\bm{\xi}\mapsto L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ takes on only one sign on $\bm{\xi}\ne0$.
blocks.zh: 若 $m$ 阶线性偏微分算子 $L$ 在 $\bm{x}_0\in\mathbb{R}^n$, $n>1$, 处椭圆, 则 $m$ 为偶整数 ($m=2k$), 且 $\bm{\xi}\mapsto L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ 在 $\bm{\xi}\ne0$ 上只取一种符号.
blocks.label: lem:elliptic-operator-even-order-fixed-sign

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
By definition, $\bm{\xi}\mapsto L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ is continuous and takes on the value $0$ only at $\bm{\xi}=0$. Suppose $L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi}_1)<0$ and $L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi}_2)>0$, and then connect $\bm{\xi}_1$ and $\bm{\xi}_2$ using a path not going through $0$. As noted, $L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ must vary continuously along the path, taking on the value $0$. This is a contradiction.

It now follows that, for any $\bm{\xi}\in\mathbb{R}^n$,\[L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})\quad\text{and}\quad L^p(\bm{x}_0,-\bm{\xi})=(-1)^mL^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})\]must have the same sign. This implies that $m$ is even.
blocks.zh:
由定义, $\bm{\xi}\mapsto L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ 连续, 且只在 $\bm{\xi}=0$ 处取值 $0$. 假设 $L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi}_1)<0$ 且 $L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi}_2)>0$, 然后用一条不经过 $0$ 的路径连接 $\bm{\xi}_1$ 和 $\bm{\xi}_2$. 如前所述, $L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ 必须沿路径连续变化, 从而取到值 $0$. 这产生矛盾.

现在得到, 对任意 $\bm{\xi}\in\mathbb{R}^n$,\[L^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})\quad\text{and}\quad L^p(\bm{x}_0,-\bm{\xi})=(-1)^mL^p(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})\]必须同号. 这说明 $m$ 为偶数.
